thread:
joan: heads-up — we got complaints from a few teams that the console spammed them with emails during yesterday's staged rollout. looking into whether notifications should be suppressed during phased propagation. anyone on the propagation semantics side?

sam: ugh — saw that too. was it the preview -> apply flow or the actual propagation broadcasts?

joan: looks like both. console shows the preview and then the apply, and we trigger `config.change` + `config.propagation` alerts for each shard. O(P) teams got 50 emails.

riley: current behavior: every node that applies a shard emits a `config.propagation.step` event, and our notifier turns those into `email`/`webhook` deliveries. probably too chatty for staged rolls.

priya: we still need auditability. can't just hide events entirely — need a suppression model that keeps audit logs + emits a single summary event.

sam: agree. proposal: add a propagation flag `suppress_notifications: true|summary_only|false`. default `false`. when `summary_only` we emit `config.propagation.summary` at the end with counts and errors.

riley: that works if the event pipeline supports aggregation windows. currently aggregation is ad-hoc in downstream services. we could add `propagation_group_id` to events so the notifier can aggregate by group id.

joan: yes — add `propagation_group_id` (UUID) and `propagation_phase` (`preview`/`apply`/`finalize`). notifier can dedupe by group + phase.

priya: also need a console UX checkbox in the rollout modal: "suppress per-node notifications (emit single summary)" with a small tooltip about audit logs still being available. product ok with that?

sam: pinging @product — but seems reasonable. low-risk change.

riley: technical note: if we delay per-node notifications, we risk hiding mid-roll failures from oncall. summary only won't help for immediate critical errors. we should keep an option `error_immediate=true` that bypasses suppression for critical error codes.

joan: good call. error_immediate default true. specify a list of severity codes that always escalate.

priya: telemetry: add events `config.propagation.started`, `config.propagation.step` (internal), `config.propagation.summary`, `config.propagation.failed` with labels: group_id, total_shards, applied, failed_shards, error_samples. that will make dashboards easier.

sam: can we add a preview API param so API users can mimic console behavior? e.g. POST /api/v1/configs/:id/propagate?notify=summary&error_immediate=true

riley: yes — simple mapping: notify param maps to internal flag. show in swagger. we'll version as `notify` for now, but we should document it in the console rollout UI and API changelog.

joan: example curl we'd document in the API guide: 

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/configs/123/propagate?notify=summary&error_immediate=true" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"targets": ["tenant:a","tenant:b"], "stages": [{"percent": 10},{"percent":100}], "propagation_group_id":"<uuid>"}'
```

priya: ops/bot idea — when summary emitted, also push a small digest to the rollout trace: list of failing tenants + links to logs, with an auto-created incident placeholder if failures > X.

ops-bot: automated note — logging the above: `config.propagation.started` group=7a4b-... user=joan env=prod

sam: ops-bot — thanks. can the notifier also add a new alerting channel `rollout-digest` instead of spamming `oncall` channel? product wants teams to opt-in to digest subscription.

riley: yeah we can wire a new channel type. backend change is mostly in notifier; small console affordance to pick digest channels.

priya: one more UX ask — preview should show "effective recipients (estimated)" and an estimated number of notifications that would be generated under current settings. helps teams understand whether to enable suppression.

joan: love that. telemetry will provide the estimate by sampling previous shard counts. add a `notification_estimate` field to the preview response.

sam: next actions: riley to spec event changes + backward compatibility plan; priya to draft console modal copy and product sign-off; joan to update rollout runbook; sam to add API docs PR. anyone object?

riley: I'll open a design doc + proto changes. will include example events and migration notes (notifier will accept old events for 2 weeks).

priya: I'll draft the modal text: "Suppress per-node notifications and emit a single summary when propagation completes. Critical errors will still be sent immediately."

joan: thanks all — let's try to get change out in the next sprint. :thumbsup:
